messages:
harper: Hey team — new Product Ops manager starts Monday. Dropping a tight manager-first-week checklist + 30/60/90 skeleton. Please flag anything we commonly miss (esp. access or compliance items). :wave:

lee: Thanks! We usually forget vendor SSO and expense card provisioning in the rush. Add those to Day1 if applicable.

harper: Good call. I'll add them. Compact checklist (copyable):
- Pre-start: confirm laptop + dock shipped, add to Slack channels, GitHub invite sent, Confluence space created, assign buddy.
- Day0 (prior to first full day): confirm device receipt, Okta + MFA setup, VPN, Google Drive + calendar access.
- Day1 AM: 30m manager 1:1 (welcome + role outcomes), 30m team intro, 15m buddy meet, 30m product overview.
- Day1 PM: environment smoke test with buddy (git, build, tokens), run a small local dev command.
- Days 2-4: two stakeholder 1:1s (eng lead, analytics/product growth), sit-in on a sprint planning or standup, start quick-win task.
- Day5: review 30/60/90 draft together; set 3 measurable 30-day outcomes and calendar checkpoints (Day14, Day30, Day60).

mike: IT note: if they need vendor SSO (Looker/Amplitude), send me the vendor list and scope now. Expense card target usually takes HR ~3 business days.

sofia: I'll be the buddy for the first 2 weeks. I'll run the build test and post the commands in #dev-experience before Day1. Plan to do a 15m midday pairing on Day1.

harper: Thanks @sofia. 30/60/90 skeleton (outcome-driven example):
30 days:
- Access: all permissions confirmed. (Success = IT checklist marked done + buddy smoke tests pass)
- Context: read 3 top customer cases + 1 technical RFC and present a 5-min summary. (Success = shared doc)
- Deliverable: ship a quick-win (doc update, small fix, or dashboard tweak). (Success = merged PR or published doc)
60 days:
- Lead: own a small experiment or feature from spec to rollout plan. (Success = spec + metrics defined + stakeholder sign-off)
- Relationships: set weekly stakeholder syncs & a cross-functional doc for handoffs.
90 days:
- Impact: deliver a measurable improvement (example: reduce onboarding time or improve activation metric). (Success = before/after metrics + brief retrospective)

lee: Small process note: managers should keep the 30/60/90 draft private until reviewed with their manager, then move it to the team Confluence page for transparency.

mike: Also: don't request elevated GCP roles until Day10 unless absolutely needed — saves time on security reviews. If you do need it earlier, please include a justification in the ticket.

harper: Quick calendar copy for Day1 1:1: "Welcome + role objectives. We'll cover immediate access, 30/60/90 expectations, and blockers. Bring questions. 30m."

sofia: For the Day1 env test I'll run: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/repo.git && yarn && yarn test` and `./run-local --env=dev`. I'll post a short checklist in #dev-experience.

hr-bot: Reminder: New hire must complete mandatory compliance courses within first 7 days. HR will send links on Day1. Managers: remind them during Day1 1:1.

harper: Perfect. Any other must-adds?

lee: Add a hiring note: discuss backfill or hiring pipeline in Week2 1:1. Recruiting wants a signal if you need support.

harper: Great — i'll share a private 30/60/90 draft with skip-level by Friday and move a short 30-day milestone to Confluence after review. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
